benefits: Several cooking methods share one appliance and inner pot.
features: Pressure cook, slow cook, sauté, steam, rice, yogurt and warm programs.
Dishwasher-safe stainless steel inner pot and lid.
Manufacturer lists 800 W, 120 V, 60 Hz for the US model.
considerations: Measure counter space, outlet access and the ventilation clearance required in the manual before buying.
Four quarts is vessel capacity, not the permitted pressure-cooking fill level; follow the manual.
An electric multi-cooker is optional equipment, not a requirement for a small kitchen.
